content.content:
=== V4 invoices ===
-- Invoices: the owner bills work against a project. Each invoice belongs to one project
-- (project_id references project.id) and carries a monetary amount. Third domain table; a project's
-- detail screen lists its invoices and shows their total.
CREATE TABLE invoice (
    id         BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES project(id),
    amount     DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL
);
=== V22 ===
-- A client's page lists its projects filtered by lifecycle: active (status ACTIVE and not archived)
-- by default, with the finished and hidden ones revealed on demand. Index the client + status +
-- archived columns so that per-client filtered lookup stays cheap as the project table grows.
-- Additive index on the existing project table (V3/V15/V21); no data change.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_client_status_archived
    ON project (client_id, status, archived);
=== V20 ===
-- An invoice's payment status is now derived from its payments: each read of a project's invoices
-- (and of a single opened invoice) sums that invoice's payments to work out whether it is PAID,
-- PARTIAL or still owing. Index payment by its owning invoice so those per-invoice aggregations stay
-- cheap. Additive index on the existing payment table (V19); no column or data change.
CREATE INDEX idx_payment_invoice_id ON payment (invoice_id);
=== V1 clients ===
-- Clients: the owner's book of clients (name + email). First domain table.
CREATE TABLE client (
    id    BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name  VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL
);
